work.title: Service-line history and analytical coverage limitation
authority: Direct user decision: preserve Challenge C without redefining its comparison window
Project Redwood invariant: do not manufacture analytical conclusions beyond available evidence

intent.productGoal: Recognize and preserve service-line change evidence while explicitly withholding a movement conclusion when the economic comparison population is insufficient.
intent.capability: Ingest service-line history separately with lineage, reconcile financial populations, detect zero prior-period coverage under the defined comparison window, and state the resulting analytical limitation.
architecturalIntent: Source history, derived comparison, and professional interpretation remain separate.
Observed insufficiency does not rewrite the source, comparison window, or intended analytical standard.
invariants: No comparison window is changed after observing its result.
No mix, rate/volume, or same-store conclusion is inferred from a zero prior population.
Truth-oracle material remains excluded and release governance remains intact.
acceptanceEvidence: Persisted run artifact and source inventory.
Browser Reconcile, Analyze, and Export observations.

decisions.decision: Freeze Challenge C as a coverage-evidence proof rather than redefine its comparison window.
decisions.rationale: Changing the basis after observing zero prior-period coverage would tune evidence to an expected narrative and weaken the test.

observedBehaviour: Service_Line_History was ingested as a separate, lineage-preserving population with Urology new_service_expansion and Dermatology service_discontinuation events.
All financial reconciliations matched and G1, G3, and G4 passed; G2, G5, G6, and G7 remained not passed.
Every service line had zero prior billed population under the defined prior-YTD window, so no historical mix movement, rate/volume decomposition, or same-store conclusion was produced.

evidence.result: Records source history events, comparison values, source inventory, reconciliations, and gates.
Shows matched reconciliation, current service-line concentration, and draft-only export governance.

divergences.expected: A populated source-supported prior-period population permits a service-line movement decomposition.
divergences.observed: Every prior YTD service-line population is zero under the pre-defined window.

durableKnowledge: Challenge C proves service-line history and analytical coverage detection, not service-line economic movement.
RS-SERVICE-LINE-MIX-002 must use a separately authored corpus with a declared prior-period population and truth oracle before Redwood sees it.
